alternatives_rejected.why: Its latency deviation (z=9.11 p90) is tiny next to emailservice's (z=883.6), which fits a caller waiting on a slow downstream (E1). Inbound calls to emailservice slowed 56x, so the delay is on the email side (E2).
It does not appear among the significant deviations in the all-services metric scan (E1), so it is only where the symptom surfaces.

proposed_fix.description: Find and remove the network delay on emailservice's interface (for example a tc netem rule or a misbehaving sidecar). Then confirm that inbound p50 to emailservice returns to about 4ms and checkoutservice latency recovers. If the source can't be found, roll the emailservice pods one at a time.
